visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. Built from components/site/v3. No mockup in this directory: the place-type class is the city/community type-card landing, not a Tetherow one-off.
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Coldwell Banker type-filtered city results. Those surfaces dump the visitor into a search grid. This page is a place-type node: leftover count and median that already back the type card, a living atlas of the parent city with the type stated in the claim, and a photographed list of that type. Unique title, canonical, ItemList when listings exist. Breadcrumb is City then type, no Home.
note: H1 is `{Type} in {Place}` and it is the page's only display-scale line: the Atlas opens under the claim wearing an eyebrow (V3Atlas headlineTone='eyebrow', subject softened to Listings). One section-0 sourced claim sentence sits under the H1 — count and ~p90 price band from ONE listing_tile_mv read, worded as the address census with the map marking for-sale homes inside city limits (pending key hidden on this page). A V3Carousel mode=rail of photographed listings (PlaceTypeFilm; shadcn-carousel adapted with side prev/next) follows Atlas in the fold with price+address+beds/baths/sqft on 800x600 plates. The Atlas section is UNCONDITIONAL via PlaceTypeAtlasSection + PlaceTypeAtlasStandin. Rows and marks share one hovered key. Unknown type notFound(). Do not collide with app/cities/[slug]/[neighborhoodSlug].

tasteReview.evaluator: npx tsx scripts/taste-evaluate.ts place-type --builder cursor-agent — grok-4.6 via cursor-cli (cursor-grok-4.6-high); grok CLI binary missing on Mini so link 1 skipped. Builder cursor-agent (tip 16b805141) did not grade the page.

shotSpec.capture: first viewport + carousel-open shots already in kit (tip 16b805141); evaluate read every PNG in shots/

tells: Carousel import ≠ photo strip — the rest-fold ON THE MARKET strip hides arrows, card body, and title-under-photo; only sheared photo tops remain until the carousel-open shots.

defects.finding: Desktop Atlas is still a pale inset: Bend sits in a modest rectangle beside a deserted cream column whose only job is a skinny Up to any price slider. The fold's job is the map under one claim occupying the first viewport, not a dashboard widget with leftover chrome.

In the rest fold the photographed rail is a 40-pixel crop of two rooftops. A visitor cannot read price, address, or specs without scrolling, so the first viewport does not carry the shadcn rail the open shots prove exists.

The opened control matches shadcn carousel (side prev/next, photo, title-under-photo, card body) but only two cards float in unused cream. The rail should fill the track the way the catalog demo fills a row, not park two Cards in a void.

SEO increment is not visible in these shots (no title or JSON-LD proof), so SEO is held. Broker reach is a header phone on desktop and missing at 375. Inventory facts on the open cards (price, address, beds, baths, sqft) are present; a held SEO line is a defect on this pass.

tasteReview.dullest: The desktop Atlas column: LISTINGS ON THE MAP and a hairline slider stranded in cream beside a washed-out density field, while the houses that would make this a place to shop are cropped into a photo sliver at the bottom.
tasteReview.beats: Zillow Bend single-family search (zillow.com/bend-or/): we win the sourced nine-in-ten asking band in one sentence and navy Atlas marks instead of Google tiles; we lose map scale, listing density, and the ability to shop inventory from the first viewport. Not a beat of that page.
tasteReview.verdict: This is a 57 on first v1-2026-09-12 mark: demoMatch is true because carousel-open shows the shadcn object (arrows, card body, title-under-photo, navy on cream), and the rest fold finally does H1 then one claim then Atlas instead of twin Amboqia titles. It is still a timid map widget over a cropped photo strip, so it does not beat Zillow Bend on the metrics that make a type page worth staying on. SEO is held, not improved; listing facts on the open cards are present, which is inventory held, not an increment the shots can prove.
tasteReview.rebaselineReason: rubricVersion v1-2026-09-10 → v1-2026-09-12; shotsHash added carousel-open desktop/mobile evidence for Tip Ready open-state. Judge (grok-4.6) scored 57 with demoMatch true — do not invent demoMatch.

contentFloor.note: No-regression floor (ci:route-content-floor). A build under any number here fails before the evaluator runs. Lower a number only by hand, in the same commit, with the reason.
